integrity: The primary preprint was inspected in full at the general sectional-curvature formula, adapted-basis lemma, and quaternionic-Heisenberg example. The proof independently derives a sharp two-variable upper bound, solves its equality conditions exactly, and verifies the mixed-term equality conditions. The bundled checker reconstructs the j-matrices from the published brackets and verifies the source's exhibited maximizer.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only the standard seven-dimensional quaternionic Heisenberg Ricci-soliton metric. It does not classify maximizers for arbitrary left-invariant metrics or all H-type groups, and it leaves the maximizing locus in intrinsic adapted-basis form rather than quotienting by the full isometry group.
title: All maximal-curvature planes in the quaternionic Heisenberg soliton
